applies_why: The judge text expressly determines that Matthew 1:20 was answered by each side in named rounds, which invokes K-G4's treatment of answered verses.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted; I weighed whether naming the verse with both sides' answers still counts it versus excluding it as answered, and the rule excludes it.
why: Because the judge says Matthew 1:20 was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness, it complies with the rule's command that an answered verse is not counted.
